specialRules.name: Piercing Growth
specialRules.description: Place one marker on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four markers. For every two markers, models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range when shooting.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Hive Bond
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to morale test rolls triggered by shooting/melee.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Unique
specialRules.description: This unit may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Destructive
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Regenerative Strength
specialRules.description: Place one marker on this model when it ignores a wound. When in melee, pick one of its weapons to get +X attacks, where X is the number of markers on it.

specialRules.name: Predator Fighter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit in melee, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Retaliate
specialRules.description: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

specialRules.name: Hive Bond Boost
specialRules.description: If all models in this unit have Hive Bond, they get +2 to morale test rolls from Hive Bond (instead of only +1).

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Furious.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane in melee.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Self-Destruct
specialRules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

specialRules.name: Stealth Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Strafing
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Furious Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Furious once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Fighter
specialRules.description: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after being in melee.

specialRules.name: Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Surprise Attack
specialRules.description: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

specialRules.name: Spawn
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it.

specialRules.name: Hive Bond Boost Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Hive Bond Boost.

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Piercing Tag
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Caster Group
specialRules.description: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Precision Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Breath Attack
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, roll one die. On a 2+ one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and AP(1).

specialRules.name: Courageous
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to morale test rolls triggered by shooting/melee.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. At any point before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Roll one die, on 4+ resolve the effect on a target in line of sight. Models within 18” in line of sight of the caster’s unit may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling, to give the caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified results of 6 to hit in melee deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

specialRules.name: Fanatic
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Grounded Reinforcement
specialRules.description: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Grounded Precision Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Grounded Precision.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Quick Shot.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and against units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Precision Shooting Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Mind Control
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Melee Slayer.

specialRules.name: Speed Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Grounded Reinforcement Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Grounded Reinforcement.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. At any point before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Roll one die, on 4+ resolve the effect on a target in line of sight. Models within 18” in line of sight of the caster’s unit may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling, to give the caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: AP

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Grounded Precision
specialRules.description: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Quick
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, or when it charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Reinforcement
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken or fully destroyed, you may remove it from the table as destroyed and place a new copy of it fully within 12" of any table edge at the beginning of the next round after Ambushers have been deployed. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.
